newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil price drops as speculation fades.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil price drops as speculation fades.

text.p: Venezuela's basket price of crude oil and oil products fell 45 cents to $17.13 per barrel in the week ending Friday, the Ministry of Energy and Mines said.

International oil traders said the fall followed a $1.00 rise in world prices in the preceding two weeks and reflected shifting market specualtion about the strength of gasoline demand in the key U.S. market.

The average basket price for May so far stood at $16.79, the Ministry said, more than a dollar above the April figure. May was the first month when prices exceeded the previous month since December last year. In that month, the basket hit a multi-year high of $21.55.
The basket closed 1996 with one of the highest average prices for several years at $18.39 against $14.84 for 1995.

In 1997 so far, the basket stood at $17.44. Venezuela's government has based its 1997 budget on an average price for the year of $14.40, although Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta has said he expects it to average higher than $15.50.
